name: BSP_ShipyardInstance_IsKindOf

name: BSP_Explosion_ApplyRadialDamage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_hit_narrowphase, read-only analysis. docs/HIT_NARROWPHASE.md. Body 0084BAD0-0084BC5F, __fastcall(centre, radius; damage, ignoreFalloff, sourceEntity, shot), SEH frame. Returns at once when the world mode [00E188A8+1FE4h] is 2. Calls 00904470 to gather the records, then per record writes the damage into +28h, calls 00470350 at 0084BBB1, writes the centre into +8h..+10h and the ignore flag into +2Ch, and queues through BSP_DeferredEntityEventQueue_Push only when record+0h differs from the source entity, so a burst never damages its own source. Finally destroys each record with 004704B0 and frees the vector. Shared by the projectile impact 0084BC60 and the flak detonation 0070C210. | Packet cc2_blast_damage: argument contract settled from the stack cleanup RET 10h at 0084BC5B. __fastcall(const float3* centre in ECX, const float* radius in EDX; const float* damage at entry+4, int ignoreFalloff at entry+8 read as a byte only by MOV AL at 0084BBC2, void* sourceEntity at entry+0Ch, void* shot at entry+10h). Neither the radius nor the damage pointer is written through. The 00428800 call at 0084BB00 precedes the world-mode test, so it runs even when the blast is suppressed. The queued impact direction is the constant (0, 1, 0): XORPS plus MOVSS from 00D7A24C, which reads 1.0f. The MOV ECX,[EAX+19CCh] at 0084BB3B is dead: 00904470 overwrites ECX with its sixth stack argument at its first instruction. Eight call sites in six containers; see docs/EXPLOSION_RADIAL_DAMAGE.md.

name: BSP_Projectile_OnImpact
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_projectile_impact, read-only analysis. __fastcall, staging buffer in ESI, body 0084BC60-0084BEFC, SEH frame. LEA ECX,[ESI+1Ch] and LEA EDX,[ESI+10h] at 0084BE18 and 0084BE1D prove the hit record starts at buffer+1Ch and the impact direction at buffer+10h. Teleports the projectile onto the impact point through [[buffer]+0CCh] (+0C8h = 1, +10Ch = 0, +FCh..+104h = hit position), routes the session hit message via BSP_Session_RouteMessage, places the decal 0084B8C0 at 0084BDEA, kills the projectile with BSP_MissionEntity_Kill(1), queues the hit with 00926E80 at 0084BE20 and spawns the explosion 0084BAD0 at 0084BEE3. docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md

name: BSP_Projectile_TraceSegmentAndImpact
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_projectile_impact, read-only analysis. __fastcall(char replayFlag, uint flags, float segment[6], shot, owner, classDesc, extra), body 0084BF00-0084C429, SEH frame. Zeroes a 70h-byte staging buffer whose first three dwords are the shot interface, the owner and the class descriptor and whose +10h is the normalised direction; +1Ch is handed to 0098B370 at 0084C1D3 as the hit record. Skips everything below the squared length 1.0e-7 at 00D0B9C0. Static trace 0084B4B0 at 0084C13F or 0084B380 at 0084C14C. Impact at 0084C314 with mode 1 and at 0084C3CF with mode 2. The [shot+0CCh] IsKindOf(0Fh) branch belongs to the other caller 007C0910, since a projectile's class id is 29h. docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md

name: BSP_Projectile_SweepStepSegment
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_projectile_impact, read-only analysis. __fastcall, RET 2Ch at 0084C4D3, body 0084C430-0084C4D5. Packs the two by-value vectors into one float[6] and tail-calls 0084BF00 at 0084C4C8 with the five remaining arguments. This corrects docs/TICK_ELEMENT_OVERRIDES.md, which reads it as the tracer: 0084BF00 traces the step segment against static geometry, sweeps entities through the spatial index and reaches the impact routine 0084BC60. docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md
